event: Ofc. Brady Kohl pulls a file that should have been closed years ago and cannot put it back.

name: Cassius Reyes
text: Cassius Reyes tells the room something about Elias Reyes that may not be true.
action: Cassius Reyes tells the room something about Elias Reyes that may not be true.

name: Rey Vasquez
action: stares hard at Nia near the hallway door
thought: She came into my house just to test how much I'll stomach.

speech.text: You tracked slush across the threshold, Nakamura.

name: Lena Ferreira
action: pulls her wool shawl tighter against the chill
thought: The cold might quiet this courtyard down enough for people to listen.

speech.text: First snow always drives the noise indoors, Tariq.

name: Simone Adeyemi
action: massages the bridge of her nose slowly
thought: Trouble always waits out the first freeze before it spills into triage.

speech.text: Clinic was quiet today, Yolanda. Tomorrow probably won't be.

name: Nadia Vasquez
action: steps between her father and the door
thought: Nia knows the porch law and she knows my father's temper.

speech.text: Say what you came for or take it outside.

name: Odette Ferreira
action: sets a repaired transistor radio on the table
thought: Fix a thing twice and people assume you owe them the labor.

speech.text: Solder held, Vic. Don't go dropping it in the snow.

name: Nia Nakamura
action: stands unmoving in the entryway of the house
thought: He wants me to look down so he can feel large.

speech.text: Snow melts, Rey. What you owe doesn't.

name: Jonah Bello
action: tucks his cold hands into his jacket sleeves
thought: Mama said to come inside once the streetlights flickered on.

speech.text: My uncle says the flakes won't stick till midnight.

event: City inspectors are working their way down Delmar with clipboards.

name: Rey Vasquez
text: Rey Vasquez takes a side in something that was not their argument.
action: Rey Vasquez takes a side in something that was not their argument.

name: June Petrakis
text: June Petrakis is working at Calloway Market.

event: The block loses power for six hours. Everything happens in the dark.

name: Farrah Mbeki
text: Farrah Mbeki moves into Kessler Housing. Nobody knows them yet.

name: Elias Reyes
text: Elias Reyes brings up, loudly, what Cassius Reyes still owes.
action: Elias Reyes brings up, loudly, what Cassius Reyes still owes.

name: Jonah Bello
action: eats toast off a paper plate quietly
thought: The big boys took the good stools again.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: marks a line in Booker's file
thought: He thinks the blackout wiped what went through the till.

speech.text: Coffee's cold. Did Brennan say if the logbook cleared?

name: Maren Adeyemi
action: stares at the flickering television screen
thought: When the power went out nobody let me hold the flashlight.

name: Booker Lyle
action: stacks three silver-plated trays by date
thought: Wes is looking at the door like someone owes him an exit.

speech.text: Sign the slip, Wes. Don't stare at the line all morning.

name: Iris Amadi
action: clips clinic admission forms into a binder
thought: Another morning where everyone in this building wants someone locked up.

speech.text: Logbook stayed on paper, Yolanda. Nothing got lost in the dark.

name: Amara Bello
action: sweeps stray hair into a corner bin
thought: Tee wants to keep sitting around waiting for another fine.

speech.text: Tee, if we don't open by nine, we lose the morning trade.

name: Wes Doyle
action: scribbles his initial onto the clipboard
thought: He thinks he owns the ink and the paper too.

speech.text: It's signed. Freight came in short two boxes, by the way.

name: Amara Bello
title: Public Haircut Ban
text: Amara Bello is taken to the 9th over Public Haircut Ban.

event: Two extra cruisers have been sitting on Delmar since this morning.

name: Farrah Mbeki
action: stacks canned goods in neat rows on the shelf.
thought: Six rows deep, labels out. Order keeps everything manageable.

speech.text: Top shelf is done. Check the invoice before opening the next crate.

name: Rey Vasquez
action: sets the plastic watering can down near Nia's feet.
thought: She knows what she did. She sits there like nothing happened.

speech.text: Move your feet or get wet, Nia. Take your pick.

name: Femi Adeyemi
action: scrubs grease off an old skillet at the sink.
thought: Her shifts are getting later. Nobody covers for her.

speech.text: Sit down before you drop, Simone. I've got the dishes.

name: Gus Petrakis
action: turns the television volume down with the remote.
thought: Cruisers on Delmar all day. Bad for dinner rush.

speech.text: Those squad cars still sitting out front by the corner?

name: Blaise Osei
action: lowers the phone and rubs his tired eyes.
thought: Forty minutes waiting on hold just to hear no.

speech.text: City licensing line plays the same bad loop all afternoon.

name: Dr. Yusuf Amin
action: blinks awake and sits up slowly on the couch.
thought: My joints ache whenever the weather turns grey like this.

speech.text: Did the pharmacy runner come by yet, Vic?

name: Tariq 'Tee' Bello
action: dries a heavy porcelain mug with a dish towel.
thought: Too much noise in here, but nobody is screaming yet.

speech.text: You want more coffee, Dev, or you just watching the soap?

event: Somebody tells Cal Mbeki that Hector Delgado has been seen talking to police.

name: Hector Delgado
action: Hector keeps his eyes off Yusuf Amin across the room.
thought: If Brennan is sitting here, nobody gets to say I came looking for him.

speech.text: Shift ended two hours ago, Sergeant. Nothing new to tell you.

name: Cal Mbeki
action: Cal puts his fork down slowly against the chipped plate.
thought: Hector talking to the law means things are moving the wrong way.

speech.text: Word is Hector was over on Riverside with the badges.

name: Otis Bello
action: Otis pulls his knees to his chest on the couch.
thought: They always turn the sound up so we don't hear them talking.

speech.text: Can we change the channel yet, Tiny?

name: Rufus Adeyemi
action: Rufus stares at the rug, tracing a faded thread.
thought: Quiet house means something went wrong, but nobody tells me.

name: Rufus Bello
action: Rufus yawns, rubbing his eyes against the pillow.
thought: Tired now.

name: Tiny Reyes
action: Tiny tosses the remote onto the low coffee table.
thought: These kids won't settle till the screen goes completely off.

speech.text: Leave it on cartoons or I'm shutting it off entirely, Otis.

name: Rey Vasquez
action: Rey glares across the table straight at Nia Nakamura.
thought: She sits in my house like she did not try to run me into the ground.

speech.text: You finished eating, Nia, or you just lingering to be difficult?

belief: Hector is talking to the cops, which means no one on this block can be trusted.

name: Cassius Reyes
belief: Elias will always humiliate me if he thinks it makes him look big.
